mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectra support peptide conformational changes in membrane-mimetic/structuring environments; this is biophysical context, not standalone antimicrobial mechanism proof.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Does not by itself prove bacterial killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Large unilamellar vesicle carboxyfluorescein-release/permeabilization assays support membrane permeabilization as a direct mechanism-related activity, with stronger effects reported for p-EM-2.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Bacterial-cell target engagement is inferred from model membranes; no receptor-specific or intracellular target assay is claimed.
